coder_notes: High-grade glioma per WHO 2021 (CNS5) without glioblastoma named anywhere in the record, so high_grade_glioma_unspecified. Sole intervention is an IL-12-armed oncolytic adenovirus (excluded type). Biodistribution is mentioned in the title but relates to the excluded virus.
